name: p-token-migrator
description: End-to-end p-token migration toolkit with scanner, simulator, dashboard, and Rust CLI.

scripts.cli:sample: cargo run --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml -- scan samples/anchor-token-vault --out data/cli-sample-manifest.json
scripts.cli:bundle: cargo run --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml -- scan samples/anchor-token-vault --bundle-out data/cli-sample-bundle --summary
